title: Affine etale neighbourhood of the image of a quasi-compact scheme
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $E$ be an algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], and let $C$ be a quasi-compact $S$-scheme [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] with an $S$-morphism $c:C\to E$. There exist an affine $S$-scheme $U$ and a representable etale morphism $u:h_U\to E$ such that the scheme projection $V=C\times_EU\to C$ is surjective, etale [def-weil-etale-morphism], separated [def-weil-proper-morphism], and locally quasi-finite [pqf-def-quasifinite]. Here affine means isomorphic to $\operatorname{Spec}A$ for a commutative ring $A$, and the fibre product is the sheaf fibre product represented by a scheme, as in [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Neither $E$ nor $S$ is assumed separated or quasi-compact, and $V\to C$ is not asserted quasi-compact.
